Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Adjustable Arm Mid-Century Modern Living Room Standing Floor Lamp - 59 Inches, Brushed Nickel
Colors: Brushed Nickel
Materials: Metal
Modern style Brushed nickel finish from base to adjustable sleek metal shade Provides ample light while fitting in a small space 10"Wx17"Dx59"H Easily assembled in 15 minutes Curl up with a good book under this adjustable floor reading lamp, which shines highly focused light. The brushed nickel finish and simple, minimalist design will add just the right modern splash to your décor.
